title: Interior C^{1,alpha} estimate on the unit ball by absorption (parent statement for x0 = 0, R = 1)
statement: Let n >= 1 and l be natural numbers, 0 < alpha < 1, lam > 0 and M real; let L := L(R^n, R^l) and B_1 := B_1(0). There is a constant C >= 0 with the following property. Let a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), Phi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L) and w : R^n -> R^l satisfy, for all x, y in B_1 and P, Q in L: (H1) lam ||P||^2 <= a(x)[P][P]; (H2) |a(x)[P][Q]| <= M ||P|| ||Q||; (H3) |a(x)[P][Q] - a(y)[P][Q]| <= M |x - y|^alpha ||P|| ||Q||; (H4) |Phi(x)[P] - Phi(y)[P]| <= M |x - y|^alpha ||P||; (H5) |w(x)| <= M; (H6) w is C^1 on B_1; (H7) there is K with ||Dw(x) - Dw(y)|| <= K |x - y|^alpha on B_1; (H8) the integral over B_1 of a(x)[Dw(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over B_1 of Phi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l with tsupport zeta in B_1. Then ||Dw(x)|| <= C and ||Dw(x) - Dw(y)|| <= C |x - y|^alpha for all x, y in B_{1/2}(0).
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → ∀ lam M : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖w x‖ ≤ M) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Rn n) 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, a x (fderiv ℝ w x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
